tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind the main work area.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Left sidebar ground. A step darker than bg so the rail reads as the shell.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Sections, side cards, the detail panel.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Hover and selected rows, active nav item, muted pills.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between table rows and around sections. Decorative only, never the only cue.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Stronger dividers, the stage track rail, empty step dots.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of chips, ghost buttons and the search field. At least 3:1 on bg, rail, surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, rail, surface, surface-2 (15:1 or more).

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: plan body, step notes, inactive nav labels. 7:1 or more on every ground.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: table headers, sub-lines, timestamps. 5.2:1 or more on every ground.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: ticket keys, primary buttons, selected chip, done stage dots, links, focus ring. 10:1 on surface.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Accent hover on lavender fills.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent fills (primary button, selected chip). 10:1 on accent.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of count badges and the run pill. accent text on it reaches 8.5:1.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Start of the stage track fill and the glow corner of the action card. Never a text ground.

tokens.name: violet-deep
tokens.usage: Middle stop of the action card ground. text reads 12:1 on it.

tokens.name: violet-night
tokens.usage: Outer stop of the action card ground.

tokens.name: on-violet
tokens.usage: Secondary text inside the action card. 5:1 on violet, its brightest stop.

tokens.name: you
tokens.usage: Waiting on you: plan to approve, escalated MR, report to read. Text on you-soft (9.4:1).

tokens.name: you-soft
tokens.usage: Pill ground for the you state.

tokens.name: client
tokens.usage: Waiting on the client (parked_needs_info). Text on client-soft (9.3:1).

tokens.name: client-soft
tokens.usage: Pill ground for the client state.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: CI green, ready_for_qa, sync dot. Text on ok-soft (8.5:1). Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Pill ground for the ok state.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: CI red, a stage that failed. Text on bad-soft (6.3:1). Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: bad-soft
tokens.usage: Pill ground for the bad state.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per screen: the project name or Tous les projets.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Detail panel ticket key, action card title.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Ticket titles, nav labels, default text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Table headers, panel sub-headings, pill text.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: File paths and identifiers in the plan. Never for labels.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon to text inside pills, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, avatars, tags.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between action rows and link buttons.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Icon to label in nav items and section titles.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Table cell block padding, step list rows.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked sections, rail padding.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Table cell and section title inline padding.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding.

tokens.name: space-22
tokens.usage: Gap between the list column and the side column.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Main area inline padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small controls, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-nav
tokens.usage: Nav items, search field.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, action rows, plan box.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sections, cards, the detail panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, status pills, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: The detail panel only, the one floating layer.
